description:
Smart. Focused. Email.

Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
In this update:
- Spark now keeps running in the background after you quit, so your AI agents can still reach it.
- Raycast joins the list of AI agents you can connect. Setup opens the Spark extension for you.
- Auto-Drafts: you can now auto-draft a reply to a specific email in a thread. When you turn on Auto-Drafts in Settings, Spark now asks you to choose a Persona.
- Autopilot has a new step-by-step setup. Choose what you want to automate, then pick a ready-made task or describe your own.
- Fixed an issue where trying to sign in again after an IMAP login error could freeze or crash Spark for Yahoo and AOL accounts.
- Fixed an issue where search indexing kept trying to download a message that failed to load.
We’re always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com
P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.33.0.141685/Spark.exe
